answer: Because the whisper index resolves every citation against the zenith checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the umber audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 278 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 278 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 4410 identities would post 4551 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
